correction.actual_resolver_mechanism: resolve_gate_momentum_buffer(model_state, opt_state, gate_key) in scripts/p5_ratio_audit/run_p5_audit.py (lines 1258-1295) calls timeshare_pretrain.build_optimizer_id_maps(model_state=model_state) -- the ONE authoritative bidirectional name<->id mapping helper (issue #580) -- and looks up muon_id = id_maps['muon_name_to_id'][gate_key].
